contentEn:
How Long Does a Condo Flooring Replacement Take in Richmond?

A condo flooring replacement in Richmond typically takes 3 to 5 days for a full unit, depending on size and whether the old flooring needs to be removed. For a standard 900–1,200 sq ft condo, the installation itself usually takes 2–3 days. Reno Stars recently completed a full flooring replacement in a Richmond high-rise condo in 5 days, including the removal of the existing floor, subfloor preparation, engineered plank installation, and refitting of all baseboards to the new floor height.

The most time-consuming step is typically subfloor preparation. If the existing subfloor has high spots, low spots, or moisture issues, leveling compound must be applied and allowed to cure for 24–48 hours before new flooring can be installed. For concrete subfloors common in Richmond high-rises, a moisture barrier may also be required before installing engineered hardwood or LVP. If the old flooring is being removed rather than installed over, add half a day to a full day for the demo work and disposal.

What Does Condo Flooring Cost in Richmond in 2026?

Condo flooring costs in Richmond in 2026 range from $7 to $25 per square foot installed, depending on the material chosen. Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) is the most budget-friendly option, typically costing $7–$14 per square foot installed. LVP is waterproof, stable under temperature fluctuations — important in high-rise condos where HVAC systems in adjacent units affect the concrete slab temperature — and available in wood-look finishes that closely mimic hardwood. A 900 sq ft condo at $10/sq ft would cost approximately $9,000 for materials and installation.

Engineered hardwood, which is the most common choice for Richmond condo renovations, costs $8–$18 per square foot installed. Engineered hardwood handles moisture and temperature changes better than solid hardwood because its cross-ply core is more dimensionally stable — critical for concrete subfloors. A 900 sq ft condo at $14/sq ft would cost approximately $12,600 for the full installation. Solid hardwood is generally not recommended for high-rise condos because the concrete subfloor and temperature fluctuations from adjacent units can cause solid wood to cup or gap over time, even with a moisture barrier.

Ceramic or porcelain tile costs $12–$25 per square foot installed and is more common in bathrooms and entryways than living areas. Tile requires a cement backer board underlayment and longer cure times, which can push a full condo installation to the higher end of the 3–5 day range. A tile installation in a 900 sq ft condo would cost approximately $13,500–$22,500.

What Is the Strata Approval Process for Flooring in Richmond Condos?

In Richmond condos, any flooring installation that affects the unit's floor structure or that of adjacent units typically requires Strata approval before work begins. Under the Strata Property Act, most Richmond condo bylaws require that a renovation application be submitted to the strata council for review. The application usually includes a scope of work description, flooring material specifications (including soundproofing underlayment details), and sometimes a contractor information form. Review timelines typically run 2–4 weeks, though some complexes with an active design review committee can take 4–6 weeks.

Soundproofing requirements are the most common reason for Strata delays in flooring applications. Many Richmond condo bylaws require a minimum IIC (Impact Isolation Class) rating of 55 or higher for flooring in multi-family buildings. LVP and engineered hardwood with a quality underlayment (3mm–6mm foam or cork) typically achieve IIC ratings of 55–65, satisfying most strata requirements. A few buildings require documentation from the flooring manufacturer showing the specific underlayment product's tested IIC rating, which the Reno Stars project manager obtains and includes in the Strata application package. Reno Stars has managed Strata approval for flooring projects in Richmond, Vancouver, and Burnaby and coordinates the full application on behalf of the unit owner.

Richmond Condo Flooring Case Study: Light Oak Engineered Plank Across Living Areas and Bedrooms

The Richmond condo Reno Stars recently renovated involved a full flooring replacement across the living areas and bedrooms of a high-rise unit. The scope included removal of the existing flooring, installation of light oak engineered plank throughout the living room, hallway, and all three bedrooms, and refitting of baseboards to accommodate the new floor height.

Light oak engineered plank was selected for its stability on the concrete subfloor and its pale finish, which complements the unit's floor-to-ceiling windows and keeps the rooms bright. The install included a 6mm cork underlayment for sound dampening, meeting the building's IIC requirement of 55. Clean transitions were installed at the entryway and bathroom thresholds where the flooring met the existing tile, with aluminum reducer strips at each transition point for a flush, safe edge.

Baseboard refitting was a critical detail in this project. New flooring installed over an old floor raises the floor height by roughly three-eighths to three-quarters of an inch, depending on the underlayment and flooring thickness. This gap between the old baseboard and the new floor exposes the drywall bottom edge if the baseboards are not removed and refitted. The Reno Stars team removed and reset all baseboards in the living areas and bedrooms, finishing them with fresh caulking at the top edge to match the original look.

How long does a condo flooring replacement take in Richmond?

A condo flooring replacement in Richmond takes 3 to 5 days for a full unit. A standard 900–1,200 sq ft condo typically completes in 3 days of installation, with an additional 1–2 days if the old flooring needs to be removed or the subfloor requires leveling compound cure time.

What is the cost per square foot for flooring in a Richmond condo in 2026?

In 2026, condo flooring in Richmond costs $7–$14/sq ft for LVP, $8–$18/sq ft for engineered hardwood, and $12–$25/sq ft for tile, all installed. A standard 900 sq ft condo at $12/sq ft engineered hardwood (mid-range) costs approximately $10,800 for materials and installation before underlayment and subfloor preparation.

Can new flooring be installed over existing tile in a condo?

New flooring can be installed directly over existing tile if the tile is solid, level, and in good condition. LVP is the best choice for this situation because it is thin enough to keep door clearances acceptable and flexible enough to bridge slight variations in the tile surface. If the tile is cracked, loose, or significantly uneven, it must be removed before new flooring is installed, which adds 1–2 days to the project.

Do Richmond condos require Strata approval for flooring replacement?

Most Richmond condo buildings require Strata approval for flooring replacement, particularly if the work involves the subfloor or may affect adjacent units through sound transmission. Applications typically take 2–4 weeks for approval. Reno Stars includes complete Strata documentation — scope of work, material specs, IIC rating data for the underlayment — with every condo flooring application to minimize back-and-forth with the strata council.

What flooring is best for a Richmond high-rise condo?

Light oak engineered hardwood or LVP in a wood-look finish are the best choices for most Richmond high-rise condos. Engineered hardwood handles the temperature fluctuations common in concrete-slab buildings better than solid hardwood and achieves a more premium look than LVP. LVP is the most cost-effective and waterproof option, making it suitable for bathrooms and kitchens, and newer LVP products closely replicate the look of natural wood.
contentZh:
列治文公寓地板更换需要多长时间？

列治文公寓地板更换通常需要3至5天完成整个单位，具体取决于面积和是否需要拆除旧地板。对于标准的900至1,200平方英尺公寓，安装本身通常需要2至3天。Reno Stars最近在本拿比一栋高层公寓完成了全套地板更换工程，包括拆除旧地板、地面 preparation、工程木板安装以及重新安装所有踢脚线以适应新地板高度，全部在5天内完成。

最耗时的步骤通常是地面 preparation。如果现有地面有高点、低点或潮湿问题，必须先铺设自流平找平层并允许其固化24至48小时，然后才能安装新地板。对于列治文高层常见的混凝土地面，在安装工程实木或豪华乙烯基塑料（LVP）之前可能还需要防潮层。如果需要拆除旧地板而不是直接铺设，则需要额外半天到一整天进行拆除和处置工作。

2026年列治文公寓地板费用是多少？

2026年列治文公寓地板费用（含安装）根据所选材料不同，每平方英尺价格在$7至$25之间。豪华乙烯基塑料地板（LVP）是最经济的选择，通常每平方英尺$7至$14。LVP防水，在温度波动下稳定性好——这对高层公寓很重要，因为相邻单位的暖通空调系统会影响混凝土板的温度——并且有仿木纹饰面，仿真度高。900平方英尺的公寓按每平方英尺$10计算，材料及安装费用约为$9,000。

工程实木地板是列治文公寓装修中最常见的选择，每平方英尺$8至$18（含安装）。工程实木地板因为其交叠芯板结构，在混凝土地面上比纯实木更能应对潮湿和温度变化。900平方英尺的公寓按每平方英尺$14计算，全套安装费用约为$12,600。纯实木地板通常不推荐用于高层公寓，因为混凝土地面和相邻单位温度波动，即使有防潮层，也可能导致实木出现翘曲或缝隙。

瓷砖每平方英尺$12至$25（含安装），比客厅更常见于浴室和入口区域。瓷砖需要水泥背板垫层和更长的固化时间，可能将整个公寓安装时间推到较高范围。900平方英尺公寓的瓷砖安装费用约为$13,500至$22,500。

Reno Stars专业从事厨房、浴室、全屋和商业装修。想获取免费、无义务的报价吗？联系 Reno Stars。

列治文公寓地板装修的共管批准流程是什么？

在列治文公寓，任何影响单位地面结构或可能影响相邻单位的装修工程，通常需要在施工前获得共管批准。根据《共管物业法》，大多数列治文公寓附例要求向共管委员会提交装修申请。申请通常包括工程范围说明、地板材料规格（包括隔音垫详情），有时还需要承包商信息表。审核时间通常为2至4周，尽管一些设有积极设计审查委员会的建筑可能需要4至6周。

隔音要求是地板申请共管延迟的最常见原因。许多列治文公寓附例要求多户住宅的地板撞击声隔声指数（IIC）不低于55。带优质垫层（3至6毫米泡沫或软木）的LVP和工程实木地板通常可达到55至65的IIC指数，满足大多数共管要求。少数建筑要求地板制造商提供具体垫层产品经测试的IIC指数文件，Reno Stars项目经理会获取并将其包含在共管申请材料包中。Reno Stars曾在列治文、温哥华和本拿比管理过地板项目的共管批准，并代表业主协调完整的申请流程。

列治文公寓地板更换需要多长时间？

列治文公寓地板更换需要3至5天完成整个单位。标准的900至1,200平方英尺公寓通常在3天内完成安装，如果需要拆除旧地板或地面需要找平层固化时间，则额外需要1至2天。

2026年列治文公寓地板每平方英尺多少钱？

2026年列治文公寓地板（含安装）费用为：LVP每平方英尺$7至$14，工程实木地板每平方英尺$8至$18，瓷砖每平方英尺$12至$25。标准900平方英尺公寓按中等价位工程实木地板每平方英尺$12计算，材料及安装费用约为$10,800，不包括垫层和地面 preparation费用。

新地板可以直接铺在现有瓷砖上吗？

如果现有瓷砖坚固、平整且状况良好，新地板可以直接铺在上面。LVP是这种情况下的最佳选择，因为它足够薄，可以保持门的间隙，并且足够灵活以适应瓷砖表面的轻微起伏。如果瓷砖破裂、松动或明显不平，则必须在安装新地板之前将其拆除，这会使工程增加1至2天。

列治文公寓地板更换需要共管批准吗？

大多数列治文公寓建筑要求对地板更换进行共管批准，特别是如果工程涉及地面或可能因声音传播而影响相邻单位时。申请通常需要2至4周批准。Reno Stars为每个公寓地板申请提供完整的共管文件——工程范围、材料规格、垫层的IIC指数数据——以尽量减少与共管委员会的来回沟通。
